Available tools:
- extract_text_from_image_url: The Image-to-Text API is a tool designed to extract text from an image. This API utilizes optical character recognition (OCR) technology to accurately identify and convert the text within an image int
- get_random_joke: Humor API lets you search through 50,000 jokes, over 200,000 memes, and gifs. From Chuck Norris, over Knock Knock to Yo Mama jokes, you'll find something for every occasion.. Get a random joke.
- rewrite_article: Automatically rewrite any given text in multiple ways.. Automatically rewrite or generate paraphrases of any given text
- repeat_send_message: Enter your webhook URL, enter how many times to send the message, and then specify the message to send. Max 10 messages.

Hey, could you help me spice up this announcement image at https://i.imgur.com/9xK2L.png by adding an office joke and sending the result 3 times to our webhook https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00000000/B00000000/XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX?
